detaileddescription.para: The MCPWM driver provides API to configure the MCPWM module. Below are the high level features supported by the MCPWM driver.

listitem.para:
2 MCPWM instances
MCPWM1 has 3 pairs of outputs and MCPWM3 has 1 pair of outputs
Can be also used as a DAC where duty cycle is equivalent to a DAC analog value.

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Timebase Configurations common for all 3 pairs of outputs
Counter Compare, Action Qualifier for each pair of outputs
Deadband between the MCPWMs common to the 3 pairs
Trip Zone configurations common to the 3 pairs.
Dedicated MCPWM cross bar, which enables selection of various trigger sources into any of the dedicated MCPWM trip inputs.

sect1.title: Important Usage Guidelines
sect1.para: The Shadow Registers and Active registers have different memories unlike EPWM. If Active registers are to be used directly, make sure the shadow loads are disabled from both local and global strobes. Else, use the shadow registers for the updates to be take at the Timebase Counter equals Zero events by default.

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <mcpwm.h>
